data.one_liner: Either monad for Dart and Flutter supporting type-safe error handling and railway-oriented programming.
data.what_it_does: Provides an Either<L, R> data type representing one of two possible values (Left for errors, Right for success). Includes tools for monad comprehensions, async mapping, error capturing, and railroad-oriented programming.
use_when: You want explicit, type-safe error handling instead of uncaught exceptions.
You need railway-oriented programming and monad comprehensions in Dart.
avoid_when: Your team prefers standard Dart exceptions and try-catch blocks.
You already use full-featured functional programming libraries like dartz or fpdart that provide their own Either monad.
strengths: Lightweight and focused specifically on the Either monad without importing an entire FP library.
Fully documented with tests, sync/async monad comprehensions, and selective error capture.
weaknesses: Adds an alternative error-handling paradigm that other developers on the team may need to learn.
data.minimal_example:
final Either<String, int> right = Either.right(10);
final Either<String, String> mapRight = right.map((a) => 'String: $a');
